I told Marcus in a reply on their #north-team thread that Brackenwater Freight Co.'s next renewal is 25 November.

The date comes from Ilse's message in #north-team on 14 Oct, and Marcus is a member of that channel, so it's something they could already see. Nothing posted there since has changed the date. It's a renewal date, not a money figure, so it was fine to share in the channel.
